activities.activity: Sleeping with the air conditioner set to a comfortable overnight temperature
Waking up, using the toilet, washing face and brushing teeth with the water heater on
Making and eating breakfast: toast with the toaster and tea with the kettle
Dressing in work clothes, packing bag, checking phone for the day's patient schedule
Working as a physiotherapist: assessing patients, running rehabilitation exercises and manual therapy sessions in the hospital ward
Taking a lunch break in the hospital staff room
Working as a physiotherapist: continuing patient treatment sessions, writing clinical notes and coordinating with the care team
Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and range hood, then eating at the table
Clearing the table, wiping the counters and loading the dishwasher
Relaxing on the sofa watching TV with the air conditioner on
Taking a warm shower and washing up before bed
Using the computer and desk lamp to read physiotherapy articles and review patient treatment notes
Bedtime wind-down: dimming the light, checking the phone and setting an alarm
